description: This Go source file defines a package 'artifacts' that manages the downloading and organization of build artifacts such as kernel images, bootloader files, and CVD bundles for a testing infrastructure (likely related to Android automotive or emulator images). It contains types and functions for creating artifact bundles, fetching specific components, and managing cached downloads with concurrency control.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: A struct responsible for managing the download and organization of build artifacts.

classes.name: CVDBundleFetcher
classes.description: An interface defining a method for fetching CVD bundle artifacts.

classes.name: registry
classes.description: A struct that caches download contexts to prevent redundant downloads.

classes.name: downloadContext
classes.description: Manages the state of a specific directory download, ensuring it executes only once.

methods.name: NewManager
methods.description: Creates a new artifact Manager with specified root directory and UUID generator.

methods.name: GetCVDBundle
methods.description: Returns the directory path of a CVD bundle, fetching it if necessary.

methods.name: GetKernelBundle
methods.description: Returns the directory path of a kernel bundle, fetching it if necessary.

methods.name: GetBootloaderBundle
methods.description: Returns the directory path of a bootloader bundle, fetching it if necessary.

methods.name: GetOrDownload
methods.description: Ensures that a directory is downloaded exactly once, caching the result.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes a download function if it has not been run before or returns cached result.
